sources.primary_title: New Taipei's Tech Ecosystem Leaps into the Middle East: 20 Companies to Showcase at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: The New Taipei City Government is leading a delegation of 20 Taiwanese technology companies to exhibit at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh, marking a significant push to expand Taiwan's tech footprint in the Middle East. The delegation will adopt a hybrid participation model, combining on-site exhibition at the New Taipei City Pavilion (Hall 3, C190) with virtual elements. The participating companies specialize in AIoT, edge computing, smart manufacturing, industrial computers, networking, cybersecurity, digital twins, and smart city applications. This initiative highlights the region's growing importance as a market for New Taipei companies seeking international growth amidst the Middle East's expanding investment in technology and infrastructure. The pavilion aims to foster connections with global buyers, system integrators, and investment partners.
